Describe what you did and what happened. Your message is sent to the project with the app version and your operating system only: no file names, no logs, no settings. There is no reply; for a conversation, use GitHub.

messages.Saves one .html file that opens in any w: Saves one .html file that opens in any web browser, with no install and no internet connection. The page contains the full transcript text, the speaker names and the chapter titles, so share it only with people who may read them.

messages.The audio is not copied into the page: i: The audio is not copied into the page: it plays “{file_name}” from where that file is now, and it records the way there (the folder names between the page and the media). Keep the page and the media file together (for example in one folder) when you move or send them.

messages.The model loads once per session. Subseq: The model loads once per session. Subsequent transcriptions start instantly.
messages.The settings run transcription on the CP: The settings run transcription on the CPU, so these are for {cpu}. Advanced > Re-detect hardware changes that.
messages.The settings run transcription on this c: The settings run transcription on this computer's {where}, so the times are for it (Advanced settings > Re-detect hardware changes that).
messages.These files are large (1–3 GB each). The:
These files are large (1–3 GB each). The default is a
private per-user cache folder that is always writable.
Pick a different folder (e.g. an external drive) if you
want to keep the models somewhere with more space.
messages.This JSON list holds no transcript segme: This JSON list holds no transcript segments.
messages.This file is not a transcript JSON (its: This file is not a transcript JSON (its root is not a list).
messages.This transcript has no text to put on a: This transcript has no text to put on a page.
messages.This video has {language} subtitles (aut: This video has {language} subtitles (automatic). Automatic subtitles can be less accurate than a transcription. Using the subtitles saves no video or audio file.
messages.This video has {language} subtitles (mad: This video has {language} subtitles (made by the uploader). Using the subtitles saves no video or audio file.
messages.Times are rough estimates for this compu: Times are rough estimates for this computer's {where}, measured on a 4-core desktop processor; a newer processor is faster, an older laptop slower.
messages.Times are rough estimates for {gpu} ({me: Times are rough estimates for {gpu} ({memory} GB), from faster-whisper's published GPU benchmark; a model too large for its memory runs on the {where} and shows that slower time.
messages.Times are rough estimates for {gpu}, fro: Times are rough estimates for {gpu}, from faster-whisper's published GPU benchmark; a model too large for its memory runs on the {where} and shows that slower time.
messages.Transcripts are saved next to the file t: Transcripts are saved next to the file they come from. The model downloads the first time you transcribe and is kept in {folder} (Advanced settings > Model folder can move it).
messages.Use the existing subtitles (seconds) or: Use the existing subtitles (seconds) or transcribe (minutes)?
